comparedAgainst: browser-02 at0.9, identical production source hashes/camera/sun/renderer
observations: Lower coverage brightens and differentiates the upper-right bank internally, but it still reads as a connected ceiling.
Morphology ON retains more directional strips and broken cloud shapes than OFF.
The fixed upper-sky region becomes brighter; absolute spatial contrast rises slightly while contrast relative to the mean decreases.
recommendation: Keep study default OFF until the queued complete-scene comparison. The 0.65 morphology-ON combination is worth that bounded comparison, without claiming a resolved sky or a quality rating.
limitations: Display-linear measurements decode the tonemapped sRGB PNG; they are not physical scene radiance.
Opaque sky alpha does not supply a cloud-occupancy mask; no pixel-coverage percentage is inferred.
192px cloud filtering differs from the full scene.
Visible-only probe does not render reflection, cloud shadow or PMREM.
